notes: Check was not separate: the Verifier ran in the same account as the builder (prototype profile, no TEAM_CHECKER), so there is no checker approval and no verified label.

F1 also shows at load: with 3 waiting pull requests, each with a preview, only 2 got Try it (ac5_optional.mjs note). Matching deployments to the waiting pull requests' branches and commits before spending the 6 status reads would fix both.

Production is recognised only by the environment's name (server/model.ts:237, ^prod(uction)?$). A deployment GitHub marks production_environment: true under another name (GitHub Pages' 'github-pages', Vercel's 'Production – <project>') gives no 'Open your app'. The spec doesn't define production, so a note.
Only a status's environment_url counts (server/github.ts:165). A host that sets only target_url gives no link. Spec silent; note.

The data still carries http:// and javascript: addresses in try_url and live_url; the page draws a link only for https (web/App.tsx:12 safeUrl, :35 AppLink), so nothing reaches the person. Filtering in the server too would be safer.

Cards that aren't waiting also show Try it when they have a preview (web/App.tsx:100). Not asked for, not forbidden.
